Leading Young Actress|Best Leading Young Actress in a TV Series]].{{cite web|url=http://www.youngartistawards.org/noms34.html|title=34th Annual Young Artist Awards|accessdate=2013-03-31|work=YoungArtistAwards.org}} Webster also played the recurring character of PeaseBlossom, an eccentric fairy in the Nickelodeon show ''The Other Kingdom.'' == Early life and education == Webster was born on August 12, 1996 in [[Toronto]], Ontario, Canada to parents Steve and Tracy Webster from the [[Don Mills]] area. As a child, Webster was always performing. She started out dancing at the age of three and loved performing on stage with her dance teams. She attended a French immersion elementary school but was drawn to the performing arts as a teen. As a teen, she attended high school at the [[Wexford Collegiate School for the Arts]] in [[Scarborough, Toronto|Scarborough]], [[Ontario]],{{cite web|url=http://metronews.ca/scene/98554/canadian-gleeks-set-to-compete-in-toronto/ |title=Canadian Gleeks set to compete in Toronto |author=Lois Abraham |publisher=The Canadian Press |work=Metro News |date=April 10, 2012 |accessdate=2016-05-23}} where she further enhanced her performing skills on stage playing leads in various musical theatre productions. She then studied musical theatre at the [[New York University Tisch School of the Arts]] in 2014, and marketing and film studies at [[Toronto Metropolitan University|Ryerson University]], where she graduated with a [[Bachelor of Arts]] (Creative Industries) with distinction in 2018.{{cite web |title=Torri Webster |url=https://ryersoncreative.ca/student-spotlight/torri-webster |website=Creative Industries at FCAD |accessdate=31 March 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Webster |first1=Torri |title=This past spring, I graduated with distinction from a business & creative program. |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/BvrnhRPBgw-/ |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/iarchive/instagram/torriwebster/2011875468613389374_2011875463571727339 |archive-date=December 25, 2021 |url-access=registration|website=Instagram |accessdate=31 March 2019}}{{cbignore}} Webster currently lives in her home town of [[Toronto]], Ontario.{{cite web |title=Toronto's Coolest Hidden Gems, According to Torri Webster |url=https://www.ellecanada.com/culture/society/torri-websters-favourite-places-in-toronto |website=www.ellecanada.com}} == Filmography == {| class="wikitable" |+ Television and film roles |- ! extract: Torri Webster (born August 12, 1996) is a Canadian actress. She is known for her starring role as Tess Foster in the YTV teen sitcom Life with Boys, which earned her the Young Artist Award for Best Leading Young Actress in a TV Series. Webster also played the recurring character of PeaseBlossom, an eccentric fairy in the Nickelodeon show The Other Kingdom.
